summary.en: What makes people remember, trust and prefer you over others.
summary.bs: Šta čini da te ljudi zapamte, vjeruju ti i biraju tebe umjesto drugih.

concepts.youtubeQuery: what is a brand explained simply

en.one: A brand is what people think and feel when they hear your name.
en.explain: It is built from every experience: the product, the service, the price, how you talk, what others say about you. The logo and colours are only the visible signs. A strong brand lets you charge more and keeps customers coming back.
en.example: Many people pay more for a known coffee brand than for an unknown one of the same quality, because they trust what they'll get.
en.why: A brand is an asset: it makes selling easier and more profitable over time.
en.mixup: A brand is not your logo. You can have a beautiful logo and a bad brand if the experience disappoints people.

bs.one: Brand (brend) je ono što ljudi misle i osjećaju kad čuju tvoje ime.
bs.explain: Gradi se iz svakog iskustva: proizvoda, usluge, cijene, načina govora, onoga što drugi kažu o tebi. Logo i boje su samo vidljivi znakovi. Jak brend ti omogućava višu cijenu i vraća kupce.
bs.example: Mnogi plaćaju više za poznati brend kafe nego za nepoznat istog kvaliteta, jer vjeruju u ono što će dobiti.
bs.why: Brend je imovina: s vremenom prodaju čini lakšom i profitabilnijom.
bs.mixup: Brend nije tvoj logo. Možeš imati prelijep logo i loš brend ako iskustvo razočara ljude.

concepts.youtubeQuery: brand identity explained logo colors tone of voice

en.one: Brand identity is the set of visible and audible signs that make you recognisable: name, logo, colours, fonts, tone of voice.
en.explain: It should match your positioning and stay consistent everywhere: shop sign, website, packaging, invoices, social posts. Consistency helps people recognise you instantly.
en.example: A children's bookshop uses bright colours, a playful font and a friendly 'Hey, little reader!' tone across its shop and Instagram.
en.why: Consistent identity makes every ad and post build on the last one, instead of starting from zero.
en.mixup: Changing your logo often doesn't refresh your brand; it mostly confuses people who were starting to recognise you.

bs.one: Brand identity (vizuelni identitet brenda) je skup vidljivih i čujnih znakova po kojima si prepoznatljiv: ime, logo, boje, fontovi, ton komunikacije.
bs.explain: Treba se slagati s pozicioniranjem i ostati dosljedan svuda: tabla na radnji, sajt, pakovanje, fakture, objave. Dosljednost pomaže ljudima da te odmah prepoznaju.
bs.example: Dječja knjižara koristi jarke boje, razigrani font i prijateljski ton 'Hej, mali čitaču!' u radnji i na Instagramu.
bs.why: Dosljedan identitet čini da svaka reklama i objava gradi na prethodnoj, umjesto da počinje od nule.
bs.mixup: Česta promjena logotipa ne osvježava brend; uglavnom zbuni ljude koji su te počeli prepoznavati.

en.one: A USP is the one thing that makes you different from competitors and matters to customers.
en.explain: It must be specific, true, and something customers actually care about. 'Good quality' isn't a USP because everyone claims it. Your value proposition is the whole promise; the USP is the sharp difference inside it.
en.example: A dry cleaner's USP: 'Ready in 3 hours, or it's free.'
en.why: A clear USP gives people one simple reason to choose you instead of the shop next door.
en.mixup: Different is not enough. Being the only shop with purple walls is unique, but no one buys because of it.

bs.one: USP (jedinstvena prodajna prednost) je ono jedno što te razlikuje od konkurenata i važno je kupcima.
bs.explain: Mora biti konkretna, istinita i nešto do čega kupcima stvarno stoji. 'Dobar kvalitet' nije USP jer to svi tvrde. Vrijednosna ponuda je cijelo obećanje; USP je oštra razlika unutar njega.
bs.example: USP hemijske čistionice: 'Gotovo za 3 sata, ili je besplatno.'
bs.why: Jasan USP daje ljudima jedan jednostavan razlog da izaberu tebe umjesto radnje do tebe.
bs.mixup: Drugačije nije dovoljno. Biti jedina radnja s ljubičastim zidovima je jedinstveno, ali niko zbog toga ne kupuje.

en.one: Brand awareness is how many people in your target market know that you exist and what you do.
en.explain: It is the top of the funnel: people can't buy from you if they've never heard of you. It grows through ads, word of mouth, PR, social media, events and a visible location. It is measured with surveys, searches for your name, or social reach.
en.example: A new burger place gives free samples at a city festival. A month later, more people search for its name online.
en.why: Awareness alone doesn't sell, but without it nothing else in marketing can work.
en.mixup: Being known is not the same as being liked. Awareness from a scandal can hurt sales.

bs.one: Brand awareness (prepoznatljivost brenda) je koliko ljudi u tvom ciljnom tržištu zna da postojiš i šta radiš.
bs.explain: To je vrh lijevka: ljudi ne mogu kupiti od tebe ako za tebe nikad nisu čuli. Raste kroz reklame, preporuke, PR, društvene mreže, događaje i vidljivu lokaciju. Mjeri se anketama, pretragama tvog imena ili dosegom na mrežama.
bs.example: Novi burger restoran dijeli besplatne zalogaje na gradskom festivalu. Mjesec kasnije više ljudi pretražuje njegovo ime online.
bs.why: Sama prepoznatljivost ne prodaje, ali bez nje ništa drugo u marketingu ne može raditi.
bs.mixup: Biti poznat nije isto što i biti omiljen. Prepoznatljivost zbog skandala može smanjiti prodaju.

en.one: Storytelling is using real stories, not just facts, to show who you are and why you matter.
en.explain: People remember stories far better than lists of features. A good brand story has a person, a problem, and a change. It can be about the founder, a customer, or how the product is made.
en.example: A honey producer from Herzegovina shares how three generations of the family have kept bees on the same hill.
en.why: Stories make you memorable and help people feel connected, which builds loyalty and word of mouth.
en.mixup: Storytelling is not making things up. Invented stories get found out and destroy trust.

bs.one: Storytelling (pričanje priče) je korištenje stvarnih priča, ne samo činjenica, da pokažeš ko si i zašto si važan.
bs.explain: Ljudi pamte priče mnogo bolje od spiska karakteristika. Dobra priča brenda ima osobu, problem i promjenu. Može biti o osnivaču, kupcu ili načinu na koji se proizvod pravi.
bs.example: Proizvođač meda iz Hercegovine priča kako tri generacije porodice drže pčele na istom brdu.
bs.why: Priče te čine pamtljivim i pomažu ljudima da se povežu, što gradi lojalnost i preporuke.
bs.mixup: Storytelling nije izmišljanje. Izmišljene priče se otkriju i unište povjerenje.

concepts.youtubeQuery: online reviews and reputation management explained

en.one: Reputation is what people say about you when you're not in the room. Today, online reviews are a big part of it.
en.explain: Most people check reviews on Google, Booking or social media before they buy. A steady stream of honest, recent reviews builds trust. How you answer bad reviews matters as much as the score.
en.example: A restaurant replies politely to a 2-star review, apologises, and fixes the slow service. Future readers see a business that cares.
en.why: A good reputation lowers your cost of getting customers, because others sell for you.
en.mixup: Fake reviews are not a shortcut. Platforms detect and remove them, and they can be illegal.

bs.one: Reputation (ugled) je ono što ljudi pričaju o tebi kad nisi tu. Danas su online recenzije velik dio toga.
bs.explain: Većina ljudi provjeri recenzije na Googleu, Bookingu ili mrežama prije kupovine. Stalan niz iskrenih, svježih recenzija gradi povjerenje. Kako odgovaraš na loše recenzije važno je koliko i ocjena.
bs.example: Restoran pristojno odgovori na recenziju s 2 zvjezdice, izvini se i popravi sporu uslugu. Budući čitaoci vide firmu kojoj je stalo.
bs.why: Dobar ugled smanjuje trošak dobijanja kupaca, jer drugi prodaju umjesto tebe.
bs.mixup: Lažne recenzije nisu prečica. Platforme ih otkrivaju i brišu, a mogu biti i nezakonite.

explain.en: A USP must be specific, true and matter to customers. Everyone claims good quality.
explain.bs: USP mora biti konkretan, istinit i važan kupcima. Dobar kvalitet tvrde svi.

options.en: What people think and feel about you
options.bs: Ono što ljudi misle i osjećaju o tebi

explain.en: Logo and colours are only signs. The brand is built from every experience people have.
explain.bs: Logo i boje su samo znakovi. Brend se gradi iz svakog iskustva koje ljudi imaju.

q.en: You get a 2-star review about slow service. What helps most?
q.bs: Dobiješ recenziju s 2 zvjezdice zbog spore usluge. Šta najviše pomaže?

options.en: Reply politely and fix the problem

explain.en: Future customers read your replies. A calm fix builds trust; fake reviews destroy it.
explain.bs: Budući kupci čitaju tvoje odgovore. Smirena popravka gradi povjerenje; lažne recenzije ga uništavaju.

q.en: Why keep brand identity consistent everywhere?
q.bs: Zašto držati identitet brenda dosljednim svuda?

explain.en: Consistency means each touchpoint builds on the last.
explain.bs: Dosljednost znači da svaka dodirna tačka gradi na prethodnoj.
